_comment: HK45 Tactical REFERENCE preset for cgs-mold (gun-dip method). Frame: draw axis = Y (rear/grip = +Y), up = Z. Cut points auto-detected then tuned visually per scan. New gun -> copy this file and retune. SOURCE OF TRUTH = ../METHOD-NOTES.md.

assemble._note: UNIVERSAL (René 2026-07-03): assemble_gun_solid UNIONS every island whose bbox-diagonal >= speck_frac x the biggest island (gun + light + rail), dropping only true specks. Replaces the HK45-era 'keep largest island', which dropped a separate light so the dip stopped at the muzzle. Raise speck_frac if scan junk survives; lower it if a small-but-real feature (compact light/laser) is being dropped.

sweep._note: sweep_dip: log-doubling voxel-union along +Y. travel=null -> full assembled Y-span (muzzle OR light bezel, whichever is furthest forward) so the dip runs the ENTIRE gun; the excess tail is cut by cut B. Only override travel to force a shorter dip on purpose. Watch front_feature_z in the return: a low Z confirms a forward light is driving the front.

solidify._note: voxel-fill the MOLD into one manifold solid before cutting; precondition for a clean boolean

decimate._note: FINAL deliverable FACE BUDGET (owner 2026-07-03: ~120-130k faces). decimate_mold auto-solves the re-solidify voxel to hit target_faces (faces ~ 1/voxel^2, one measure+correct). ★ The RE-SOLIDIFY voxel — NOT the decimate — sets final density (the remesh regenerates), so keep `times` low; heavy decimation only sheds detail. Glock 43X: solved voxel 0.588 -> 125078 faces.

grip_cut._note: TWO cuts. Cut A (cut_grip): diagonal cube DIFFERENCE, corner (trigger-guard/grip knee) -corner_below, beavertail -beavertail_below. Cut B (cut_tail): vertical trim at gun_rear + tail_margin, removes the dip's excess tail without shortening the real beavertail. SCAN-RELATIVE (2026-07-03): knee = proportional (15% of plateau->grip depth), beavertail = rearmost upper-grip vert in the REAL gun region (dip tail excluded via obj['gun_rear_y']), cube auto-sized from bbox. No HK45 absolute Z bands. corner_below/beavertail_below stay owner-tunable (render-verify). Validated on HK45, Glock 43X + TLR-7.

smooth._note: VALIDATED 2026-06-30. 4-stage feature-preserving: flat denoise -> crease de-zigzag -> roughness deburr -> re-straighten. Smooth AND sharp.

offset._note: Region = barrel+slide+beavertail ONLY (Z>z_line), NOT global. SCAN-RELATIVE (2026-07-03): z_line=null auto-seeds to zmin + z_frac*(zmax-zmin) of the mold's own height (was the HK45 absolute 14mm). On the Glock 43X that landed z_line=+16.4 at the slide/frame line. Render-verify the boundary; nudge z_frac (or set z_line explicitly) per scan. Feathered 2mm.

split._deprecated: 2026-07-03 owner directive: DO NOT split anymore. After decimate, export the single mold via export_mold. split_mold + _bore_center_x kept in the engine for reference only, out of the pipeline.

export._note: export_mold writes ONE STL <out_dir>\<gun-name>.stl (fixed handoff folder). Single piece, no split.
